Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
          definition:
          users:Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u | u.SuspensionDays > 0)
            
            precondition:
          users->notEmpty()
            
            postcondition:
          users->forAll(u:User|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays - 1 and (u.SuspensionDays <= 0 implies u.BorrowStatus = REMODEL::BorrowStatus::SUSPEND))
            
        }
